quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing for the custom ASIC design and development contract first disclosed 12-26-2025 (signed 12-24-2025, customer undisclosed at its request): the contract end date, and the disclosure-withholding deadline, move from 10-01-2026 to 10-01-2027. Amount KRW 17,880,400,000 ex-VAT, non-conditional, 18.53% of 2024 consolidated revenue (KRW 96,492,001,688); both own and outsourced production; payment within 30 days of meeting payment conditions. Amount and term may change as the design progresses.
